description: Irreversibly mark the FULL remaining expense balance reimbursed externally. Records an already completed outside-OFW reimbursement only: does NOT send money or use bank/payment endpoints; no partial amounts. Requires expectedRemainingAmount (currency units, positive exact cents) matching the current leftToPay, NOT the full expense total. Reads the current expense, binds the entire detail to confirmation, rechecks immediately before writing, then verifies paid status and unchanged fields. Cannot be undone. On EXPENSE_REIMBURSEMENT_UNCONFIRMED, mayHaveLanded=true: inspect the OFW Expenses log before any retry; never replay blindly. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call performs NO write and returns a preview of exactly what would happen plus a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

expectedRemainingAmount.description: Full remaining external reimbursement in currency units (e.g. 48.50); must match leftToPay, not the expense total

name: ofw_mark_expense_reimbursed
